messages:
hannah: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands  need clarifications so AEs can act this week.
hannah: 1) Should inbound trials be POC or Opportunity in SFDC? 2) What's the partner co-sell pilot terms? 3) Where do we point AEs for Hosted -> Dedicated guidance?
diego: Inbound trials = POC until signed PO or active subscription. Add expected close date in POC field.
sofia: Partner pilot = registered partners only, 10% co-sell credit for Q2 pilot, no retro credits. Registration flow in #partners.
sofia: Partner ops will run office hours weekly to review regs and pipeline influence.
lee: For Hosted vs Dedicated: default to Hosted for trials and early production. Recommend Dedicated for data residency, sustained throughput needs, or when customer requests pinned models.
lee: I'll publish a one-pager decision tree and a 2-line AE pitch by EOD.
hannah: Can Sales Ops confirm who owns the Dedicated cost calc for quotes?
diego: Sales Ops owns the final quote template; Eng Infra provides GPU sizing inputs.
ops-bot: Recording + slides uploaded -> https://redwood.co/all-hands/1787654321
hannah: Nice. Action items recap: Lee  one-pager + pitch; Sofia  partner pilot doc + office hours; Diego  confirm quote owner with Sales Ops. Please react :white_check_mark: when done.
lee: :white_check_mark: one-pager and pitch posted.
sofia: :white_check_mark: partner doc + office hours calendar.
diego: :white_check_mark: confirmed with Sales Ops.
hannah: Thanks team, closing thread. :v:
